Author: Deuflhard
Description: ETK 854 ActiveHybrid 35d Performance (N57S 500) - upgraded-turbo build based on the 3.0 L I6 twin-turbo diesel (N57D30TOP). Instead of the stock sequential turbochargers, the larger Stage 3 turbocharger is fitted as standard and runs 3.4 bar absolute boost: 369 kW (502 PS) at about 4450 rpm and up to 888 Nm (plateau 1800-3000 rpm), rev limiter unchanged at 5400 rpm. Strengthened internals (conrods, pistons, bolts) carry the torque; as on real road builds, the control unit limits system torque electronically - here to 950 Nm in stock form and up to 1320 Nm with the E-Boost stages. Also fitted: carbon-ceramic brakes, the Performance cooling package (auxiliary radiator in the airflow + oil cooler, no overheating even on long full-throttle stretches), K0 disconnect clutch and P2 e-machine (83 kW / 265 Nm at Stage 0) ahead of the converter, 8-speed automatic, 2.81 rear axle ratio, RWD. 13.5 kWh battery, 50 L diesel tank. System output 452 kW (615 PS). Response is marginally slower than the stock setup - the larger turbo needs around 0.43 s instead of 0.36 s to reach stock boost, still only a fraction of the base engine's spool time. Sailing, recuperation and all-electric pull-away are retained. Delivered without a factory top-speed limiter.
